targets.query:
SELECT 
  non_negative_difference(last("100_p_01_lift_station_pump_runtime_hr_total")) AS "Lift Station Pump 1",
  non_negative_difference(last("100_p_02_lift_station_pump_runtime_hr_total")) AS "Lift Station Pump 2",
  non_negative_difference(last("101_p_01_equalization_transfer_pump_runtime_hr_total")) AS "EQ Transfer Pump",
  non_negative_difference(last("101_bs_02_auto_screen_runtime_hr_total")) AS "Auto Screen",
  non_negative_difference(last("202_fs_01_finescreen_runtime_hr_total")) AS "Fine Screen 1",
  non_negative_difference(last("202_fs_02_finescreen_runtime_hr_total")) AS "Fine Screen 2",
  non_negative_difference(last("201_b_01_aeration_blower_runtime_hr_total")) AS "Aeration Blower 1",
  non_negative_difference(last("201_b_02_aeration_blower_runtime_hr_total")) AS "Aeration Blower 2",
  non_negative_difference(last("202_ag_01_anaerobic_agitator_runtime_hr_total")) AS "Anaerobic Agitator",
  non_negative_difference(last("202_ag_02_anoxic_agitator_runtime_hr_total")) AS "Anoxic Agitator",
  non_negative_difference(last("202_b_01_mbr_blower_runtime_hr_total")) AS "MBR Scour Blower 1",
  non_negative_difference(last("202_b_02_mbr_blower_runtime_hr_total")) AS "MBR Scour Blower 2",
  non_negative_difference(last("202_p_01_mbr_permeate_pump_running_hour")) AS "MBR Permeate Pump",
  non_negative_difference(last("202_p_05_cip_pump_runtime_hr_total")) AS "CIP Pump",
  non_negative_difference(last("501_p_01_dewatering_feed_pump_runtime_hr_total")) AS "Dewatering Feed Pump 1",
  non_negative_difference(last("501_p_02_dewatering_feed_pump_runtime_hr_total")) AS "Dewatering Feed Pump 2",
  non_negative_difference(last("401_p_01_dwpe_dosing_pump_runtime_hr_total")) AS "DWPE Dosing Pump"
FROM "plc" 
WHERE $timeFilter 
GROUP BY time(1d) tz('Asia/Kolkata')
SELECT last(/_lsl_|_lsh_|_psh_/) FROM "plc" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

targets.query:
SELECT 
  last("100_p_01_lift_station_pump_runtime_hr_total") AS "Lift Station Pump 1",
  last("100_p_02_lift_station_pump_runtime_hr_total") AS "Lift Station Pump 2",
  last("101_p_01_equalization_transfer_pump_runtime_hr_total") AS "EQ Transfer Pump",
  last("101_bs_02_auto_screen_runtime_hr_total") AS "Auto Screen",
  last("202_fs_01_finescreen_runtime_hr_total") AS "Fine Screen 1",
  last("202_fs_02_finescreen_runtime_hr_total") AS "Fine Screen 2",
  last("201_b_01_aeration_blower_runtime_hr_total") AS "Aeration Blower 1",
  last("201_b_02_aeration_blower_runtime_hr_total") AS "Aeration Blower 2",
  last("202_ag_01_anaerobic_agitator_runtime_hr_total") AS "Anaerobic Agitator",
  last("202_ag_02_anoxic_agitator_runtime_hr_total") AS "Anoxic Agitator",
  last("202_b_01_mbr_blower_runtime_hr_total") AS "MBR Scour Blower 1",
  last("202_b_02_mbr_blower_runtime_hr_total") AS "MBR Scour Blower 2",
  last("202_p_01_mbr_permeate_pump_running_hour") AS "MBR Permeate Pump",
  last("202_p_05_cip_pump_runtime_hr_total") AS "CIP Pump",
  last("501_p_01_dewatering_feed_pump_runtime_hr_total") AS "Dewatering Feed Pump 1",
  last("501_p_02_dewatering_feed_pump_runtime_hr_total") AS "Dewatering Feed Pump 2",
  last("401_p_01_dwpe_dosing_pump_runtime_hr_total") AS "DWPE Dosing Pump"
FROM "plc"

SELECT 
  (last("100_p_01_lift_station_pump_run_fb") * 1) + (last("100_p_01_lift_station_pump_trip_fb") * 2) AS "Lift Pump 1",
  (last("100_p_02_lift_station_pump_run_fb") * 1) + (last("100_p_02_lift_station_pump_trip_fb") * 2) AS "Lift Pump 2",
  (last("101_p_01_equalization_transfer_pump_run_fb") * 1) + (last("101_p_01_equalization_transfer_pump_trip_fb") * 2) AS "EQ Transfer Pump",
  (last("101_bs_02_auto_screen_run_fb") * 1) + (last("101_bs_02_auto_screen_trip_fb") * 2) AS "Auto Screen",
  (last("202_fs_01_finescreen_run_fb") * 1) + (last("202_fs_01_finescreen_trip_fb") * 2) AS "Fine Screen 1",
  (last("202_fs_02_finescreen_run_fb") * 1) + (last("202_fs_02_finescreen_trip_fb") * 2) AS "Fine Screen 2"
FROM "plc" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)

  (last("201_b_02_aeration_blower_run_fb") * 1) + (last("201_b_02_aeration_blower_trip_fb") * 2) AS "Aeration Blower 2",
  (last("202_ag_01_anaerobic_agitator_run_fb") * 1) + (last("202_ag_01_anaerobic_agitator_trip_fb") * 2) AS "Anaerobic Agitator",
  (last("202_ag_02_anoxic_agitator_run_fb") * 1) + (last("202_ag_02_anoxic_agitator_trip_fb") * 2) AS "Anoxic Agitator"
FROM "plc" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)

SELECT 
  (last("202_b_01_mbr_blower_run_fb") * 1) + (last("202_b_01_mbr_blower_trip_fb") * 2) AS "MBR Scour Blower 1",
  (last("202_b_02_mbr_blower_run_fb") * 1) + (last("202_b_02_mbr_blower_trip_fb") * 2) AS "MBR Scour Blower 2",
  (last("202_p_01_mbr_permeate_pump_run_fb") * 1) + (last("202_p_01_mbr_permeate_pump_trip_fb") * 2) AS "MBR Permeate Pump",
  (last("202_p_05_cip_pump_run_fb") * 1) + (last("202_p_05_cip_pump_trip_fb") * 2) AS "CIP Pump"
FROM "plc" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)

SELECT 
  (last("501_p_01_dewatering_feed_pump_run_fb") * 1) + (last("501_p_01_dewatering_feed_pump_trip_fb") * 2) AS "Dewatering Pump 1",
  (last("501_p_02_dewatering_feed_pump_run_fb") * 1) + (last("501_p_02_dewatering_feed_pump_trip_fb") * 2) AS "Dewatering Pump 2",
  (last("401_p_01_dwpe_dosing_pump_run_fb") * 1) + (last("401_p_01_dwpe_dosing_pump_trip_fb") * 2) AS "DWPE Dosing Pump"
FROM "plc" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)
